Definition: from a compound of G1722 and G5316; apparent in self:--manifest, openly.
BiblicalUsage: Emphanes means openly shown, made manifest. God raised Jesus the third day and showed Him openly in Acts 10:40 — not to everyone, but to chosen witnesses — and Isaiah says God was made manifest to those who did not even ask for Him in Romans 10:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God shows Himself openly to those He chooses, and even to those who were not looking, which gives me hope for everyone I love who is not looking yet.
